import os
os.environ["JAX_PLATFORMS"] = "cpu"
os.environ["XLA_FLAGS"] = "--xla_force_host_platform_device_count=4"
os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = ""

import sys
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats as sp_stats

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "mvp"))
from data_gen import generate_gated_mfrm_data
from models import fit_sequential

# ═══════════════════════ Unified Style ��══════════════════════

STYLE = {
    "figsize_single": (4.5, 3.2),
    "figsize_triple": (13.5, 3.2),
    "dpi": 300,
    "font.size": 10,
    "axes.labelsize": 12,
    "axes.titlesize": 12,
    "xtick.labelsize": 10,
    "ytick.labelsize": 10,
    "legend.fontsize": 10,
    "grid_alpha": 0.3,
    "grid_ls": "--",
}

COLORS = {"sequential": "#e41a1c", "joint": "#377eb8"}
MARKERS = {"sequential": "o", "joint": "s"}

OUTPUT_DIR = "/root/figures/paper"


def apply_style():
    plt.rcParams.update({
        "font.size": STYLE["font.size"],
        "axes.labelsize": STYLE["axes.labelsize"],
        "axes.titlesize": STYLE["axes.titlesize"],
        "xtick.labelsize": STYLE["xtick.labelsize"],
        "ytick.labelsize": STYLE["ytick.labelsize"],
        "legend.fontsize": STYLE["legend.fontsize"],
        "axes.spines.top": False,
        "axes.spines.right": False,
        "pdf.fonttype": 42,
        "ps.fonttype": 42,
    })


def add_grid(ax):
    ax.grid(True, alpha=STYLE["grid_alpha"], linestyle=STYLE["grid_ls"])
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)


def save_fig(fig, name):
    for ext in ["pdf", "png"]:
        path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f"{name}.{ext}")
        fig.savefig(path, dpi=STYLE["dpi"], bbox_inches="tight")
    print(f"  Saved: {OUTPUT_DIR}/{name}.pdf/png")


# ═══════════════════════ Figure 2a: OVB Bias Scatter ═══════════════════════

def generate_ovb_scatter_data(N=50, I=100, J=8, rho=0.6, n_seeds=20):
    all_c_true = []
    all_bias = []
    for seed in range(n_seeds):
        print(f"    seed {seed}/{n_seeds}", flush=True)
        data = generate_gated_mfrm_data(N=N, I=I, J=J, rho=rho, seed=seed)
        theta_true = data["true_params"]["theta"]
        theta_true_c = theta_true - theta_true.mean()
        c_true = data["true_params"]["c"]
        e_values = data["true_params"]["e"]
        seq = fit_sequential(data, e_values)
        bias = seq["theta_hat"] - theta_true_c
        all_c_true.extend(c_true.tolist())
        all_bias.extend(bias.tolist())
    return np.array(all_c_true), np.array(all_bias)


def plot_fig2_ovb_bias():
    print("Generating fig2_ovb_bias...")
    all_c, all_bias = generate_ovb_scatter_data()
    r, p = sp_stats.pearsonr(all_c, all_bias)
    print(f"  Pearson r={r:.4f}, p={p:.6f}")

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=STYLE["figsize_single"])
    ax.scatter(all_c, all_bias, alpha=0.35, s=12, c=COLORS["sequential"],
               edgecolors="none", zorder=2)
    ax.axhline(0, color="gray", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.6)

    z = np.polyfit(all_c, all_bias, 1)
    x_line = np.linspace(all_c.min(), all_c.max(), 100)
    ax.plot(x_line, np.polyval(z, x_line), color="#222222", linewidth=1.8,
            label=f"$r = {r:.2f}$", zorder=3)

    ax.set_xlabel(r"$c_n$ (true contamination susceptibility)")
    ax.set_ylabel(r"$\hat{\theta}_{\mathrm{seq}} - \theta_{\mathrm{true}}$")
    ax.legend(loc="upper left", framealpha=0.9)
    add_grid(ax)
    fig.tight_layout()
    save_fig(fig, "fig2_ovb_bias")
    plt.close(fig)


# ════════��══════════════ Figure 4: Bias vs Rho ═══════════════════════

def plot_fig4_bias_vs_rho():
    print("Generating fig4_bias_vs_rho...")
    csv_path = "/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp009/bias_vs_rho.csv"
    df = pd.read_csv(csv_path)

    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=STYLE["figsize_triple"])

    metrics = [
        ("bias_slope", r"Bias slope $\beta_1(\hat{\theta}-\theta \sim c_n)$",
         "Bias Slope"),
        ("rmse", r"RMSE ($\theta$ recovery)", "RMSE"),
        ("kendall_tau", r"Kendall $\tau$", "Ranking Accuracy"),
    ]

    for ax, (col, ylabel, title) in zip(axes, metrics):
        for method in ["sequential", "joint"]:
            sub = df[df["method"] == method]
            g = sub.groupby("rho")
            x = g[col].mean().index.values
            y = g[col].mean().values
            ci = 1.96 * g[col].std().values / np.sqrt(g.size().values)
            ax.plot(x, y, marker=MARKERS[method], color=COLORS[method],
                    label=method.capitalize(), linewidth=1.8, markersize=5)
            ax.fill_between(x, y - ci, y + ci, color=COLORS[method], alpha=0.12)

        if col == "bias_slope":
            ax.axhline(0, color="gray", ls="--", alpha=0.5, linewidth=0.8)

        ax.set_xlabel(r"Confounding strength ($\rho$)")
        ax.set_ylabel(ylabel)
        ax.legend(framealpha=0.9)
        add_grid(ax)

    fig.tight_layout()
    save_fig(fig, "fig4_bias_vs_rho")
    plt.close(fig)


# ═══════════════════════ Main ══���════════════════════

if __name__ == "__main__":
    apply_style()
    os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    plot_fig2_ovb_bias()
    plot_fig4_bias_vs_rho()
    print("\nDone. All figures saved to:", OUTPUT_DIR)

def setup_style():

def trace_plot(samples, names, suptitle, filename):
    """Trace + marginal density plot.

    samples: (n_chains, n_draws, n_params) or (n_chains, n_draws)
    """
    if samples.ndim == 2:
        samples = samples[:, :, np.newaxis]
    if isinstance(names, str):
        names = [names]

    n_chains, n_draws, n_params = samples.shape
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        n_params, 2, figsize=(13, 2.6 * n_params + 0.8),
        squeeze=False, gridspec_kw={"width_ratios": [3.5, 1]},
    )

    for i in range(n_params):
        ax_t, ax_d = axes[i]
        for ch in range(n_chains):
            vals = samples[ch, :, i]
            ax_t.plot(vals, alpha=0.45, lw=0.25, color=CHAIN_COLORS[ch],
                      rasterized=True)
            ax_d.hist(vals, bins=60, alpha=0.3, density=True,
                      color=CHAIN_COLORS[ch], orientation="horizontal")
            from scipy.stats import gaussian_kde
            try:
                kde = gaussian_kde(vals)
                grid = np.linspace(vals.min(), vals.max(), 200)
                ax_d.plot(kde(grid), grid, color=CHAIN_COLORS[ch],
                          lw=1.0, alpha=0.8)
            except Exception:
                pass

        ax_t.set_ylabel(names[i], fontsize=9)
        ax_d.set_ylabel("")
        ax_d.tick_params(labelleft=False)

        if i == 0:
            handles = [plt.Line2D([0], [0], color=c, lw=1.5)
                       for c in CHAIN_COLORS[:n_chains]]
            ax_t.legend(handles, [f"Chain {c}" for c in range(n_chains)],
                        fontsize=7, ncol=4, loc="upper right",
                        framealpha=0.7)
        if i < n_params - 1:
            ax_t.tick_params(labelbottom=False)
        else:
            ax_t.set_xlabel("Draw", fontsize=9)

    fig.suptitle(suptitle, fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", y=1.005)
    fig.tight_layout()
    _save(fig, filename)


def forest_plot(samples, names, suptitle, filename, hdi_prob=0.94):
    """Forest plot with HDI bars and posterior means.

    samples: (n_chains, n_draws, n_params)
    """
    n_params = len(names)
    flat = samples.reshape(-1, n_params)

    means = flat.mean(axis=0)
    alpha = 1 - hdi_prob
    lo = np.percentile(flat, 100 * alpha / 2, axis=0)
    hi = np.percentile(flat, 100 * (1 - alpha / 2), axis=0)

    order = np.argsort(means)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, max(0.45 * n_params + 1.2, 3.5)))
    y_pos = np.arange(n_params)

    for rank, orig_idx in enumerate(order):
        ax.plot([lo[orig_idx], hi[orig_idx]], [rank, rank],
                color="#4878d0", lw=2.8, solid_capstyle="round", alpha=0.85)
        ax.plot(means[orig_idx], rank, "o", color="#222222",
                markersize=4.5, zorder=5)

    ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
    ax.set_yticklabels([names[i] for i in order], fontsize=9)
    ax.set_xlabel("Posterior estimate", fontsize=10)
    ax.axvline(0, color="gray", ls="--", lw=0.8, alpha=0.5)
    ax.set_title(f"{suptitle}\n(● = mean, bar = {int(hdi_prob*100)}% CI)",
                 fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
    ax.margins(y=0.06)
    fig.tight_layout()
    _save(fig, filename)


def _save(fig, filename):
    path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, filename)
    fig.savefig(path, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)
    kb = os.path.getsize(path) / 1024
    print(f"  {filename}: {kb:.1f} KB")

import pandas as pd

from scipy import stats as sp_stats
import arviz as az

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "mvp"))
from data_gen import generate_gated_mfrm_data
from models import fit_sequential

# ═══════════════════════ Unified PAPER_STYLE ═══════════════════════

PAPER_STYLE = {
    'font.family': 'serif',

    'grid.alpha': 0.3,
    'grid.linestyle': '--',
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'pdf.fonttype': 42,
    'ps.fonttype': 42,
}

OUTPUT_DIR = "/root/figures/paper"
NC_GMFRM = "/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp003/output_003b/joint_gmfrm_idata.nc"
NC_MFRM = "/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/exp003/output_003b/mfrm_only_idata.nc"

MODEL_NAMES = [
    "gemma-2-9b", "gpt-3.5-turbo-0125", "gpt-4-0613", "gpt-4o",

JUDGE_NAMES = [
    "claude-opus-4.7-proxy", "claude-sonnet-4.6-proxy", "deepseek-v4-pro-proxy",
    "gemini-2.5-pro-proxy", "gpt-5.5-proxy", "llama-3.3-70b",
    "mistral-large-2", "qwen2.5-72b", "qwen3-235b-proxy",
]

COLORS = {"sequential": "#e41a1c", "joint": "#377eb8"}


def apply_style():
    mpl.rcParams.update(PAPER_STYLE)


def save_fig(fig, name):
    for ext in ["pdf", "png"]:
        path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f"{name}.{ext}")
        fig.savefig(path, dpi=300, bbox_inches="tight")
    print(f"  Saved: {OUTPUT_DIR}/{name}.pdf/png")


# ═══════════════════════ Figure 2: OVB Bias Scatter ═══════════════════════

def generate_ovb_scatter_data(N=50, I=100, J=8, rho=0.6, n_seeds=20):
    all_c_true, all_bias = [], []
    for seed in range(n_seeds):
        print(f"    seed {seed}/{n_seeds}", flush=True)
        data = generate_gated_mfrm_data(N=N, I=I, J=J, rho=rho, seed=seed)
        theta_true = data["true_params"]["theta"]
        theta_true_c = theta_true - theta_true.mean()
        c_true = data["true_params"]["c"]
        e_values = data["true_params"]["e"]
        seq = fit_sequential(data, e_values)
        bias = seq["theta_hat"] - theta_true_c
        all_c_true.extend(c_true.tolist())
        all_bias.extend(bias.tolist())
    return np.array(all_c_true), np.array(all_bias)


def plot_fig2_ovb_bias():
    print("Generating fig2_ovb_bias...")
    all_c, all_bias = generate_ovb_scatter_data()
    r, p = sp_stats.pearsonr(all_c, all_bias)
    print(f"  Pearson r={r:.4f}, p={p:.6f}")

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.8))
    ax.scatter(all_c, all_bias, alpha=0.35, s=12, c=COLORS["sequential"],
               edgecolors="none", zorder=2)
    ax.axhline(0, color="gray", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.6)

    z = np.polyfit(all_c, all_bias, 1)
    x_line = np.linspace(all_c.min(), all_c.max(), 100)
    ax.plot(x_line, np.polyval(z, x_line), color="#222222", linewidth=1.8,
            label=f"$r = {r:.2f}$", zorder=3)

    ax.set_xlabel(r"$c_n$ (true contamination susceptibility)")
    ax.set_ylabel(r"$\hat{\theta}_{\mathrm{seq}} - \theta_{\mathrm{true}}$")
    ax.legend(loc="upper left", framealpha=0.9)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    fig.tight_layout()
    save_fig(fig, "fig2_ovb_bias")
    plt.close(fig)


# ═══════════════════════ Forest Plot: Judge Severity ═══════════════════════

def plot_forest_dj():
    print("Generating forest_dj...")
    idata = az.from_netcdf(NC_GMFRM)
    d = idata.posterior["d"].values  # (4, 4000, 9)
    n_judges = len(JUDGE_NAMES)
    flat = d.reshape(-1, n_judges)

    means = flat.mean(axis=0)
    lo = np.percentile(flat, 3, axis=0)
    hi = np.percentile(flat, 97, axis=0)

    order = np.argsort(means)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.8))
    y_pos = np.arange(n_judges)

    for rank, idx in enumerate(order):
        ax.plot([lo[idx], hi[idx]], [rank, rank],
                color="#4878d0", lw=2.2, solid_capstyle="round", alpha=0.85)
        ax.plot(means[idx], rank, "o", color="#222222", markersize=3.5, zorder=5)

    ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
    ax.set_yticklabels([JUDGE_NAMES[i] for i in order], fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlabel(r"$\hat{d}_j$ (judge severity)")
    ax.axvline(0, color="gray", ls="--", lw=0.8, alpha=0.5)
    ax.margins(y=0.06)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    fig.tight_layout()
    save_fig(fig, "forest_dj")
    plt.close(fig)


# ═══════════════════════ Contamination Bars ═══════════════════════

def plot_contamination_bars():
    print("Generating fig_contamination_bars...")
    idata = az.from_netcdf(NC_GMFRM)
    c = idata.posterior["c"].values  # (4, 4000, 8)
    n_models = len(MODEL_NAMES)
    flat = c.reshape(-1, n_models)

    means = flat.mean(axis=0)
    lo = np.percentile(flat, 3, axis=0)
    hi = np.percentile(flat, 97, axis=0)

    order = np.argsort(means)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.8))
    y_pos = np.arange(n_models)

    names_sorted = [MODEL_NAMES[i] for i in order]
    means_sorted = means[order]
    xerr = np.array([means_sorted - lo[order], hi[order] - means_sorted])

    cmap = plt.cm.RdYlGn_r(np.linspace(0.2, 0.8, n_models))

    ax.barh(y_pos, means_sorted, xerr=xerr, color=cmap,
            capsize=2, edgecolor="none", height=0.7)

    ax.set_yticks(y_pos)
    ax.set_yticklabels(names_sorted, fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlabel(r"$\hat{c}_n$ (contamination susceptibility)")
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    fig.tight_layout()
    save_fig(fig, "fig_contamination_bars")
    plt.close(fig)


# ═══════════════════════ Bias Absorption Scatter ═══════════════════════

def plot_bias_absorption():
    print("Generating fig_bias_absorption...")
    gmfrm = az.from_netcdf(NC_GMFRM)
    mfrm = az.from_netcdf(NC_MFRM)

    n = len(MODEL_NAMES)

    theta_gmfrm = gmfrm.posterior["theta"].values.reshape(-1, n)
    theta_mfrm = mfrm.posterior["theta"].values.reshape(-1, n)

    c_mean = c_flat.mean(axis=0)
    theta_diff = theta_mfrm.mean(axis=0) - theta_gmfrm.mean(axis=0)

    r, p = sp_stats.pearsonr(c_mean, theta_diff)
    print(f"  Pearson r={r:.4f}, p={p:.4f}")

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.5, 2.8))
    ax.scatter(c_mean, theta_diff, s=30, c=COLORS["joint"],
               edgecolors="white", linewidths=0.5, zorder=3)

    for i, name in enumerate(MODEL_NAMES):
        ax.annotate(name, (c_mean[i], theta_diff[i]),
                    textcoords="offset points", xytext=(4, 4), fontsize=6)

    z = np.polyfit(c_mean, theta_diff, 1)
    x_line = np.linspace(c_mean.min() - 0.3, c_mean.max() + 0.3, 100)
    ax.plot(x_line, np.polyval(z, x_line), color="#222222", linewidth=1.5,
            ls="--", alpha=0.7, label=f"$r = {r:.2f}$", zorder=2)

    ax.axhline(0, color="gray", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.4)
    ax.set_xlabel(r"$\hat{c}_n$ (contamination susceptibility)")
    ax.set_ylabel(r"$\hat{\theta}_{\mathrm{MFRM}} - \hat{\theta}_{\mathrm{G\text{-}MFRM}}$")
    ax.legend(loc="best", framealpha=0.9)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)
    fig.tight_layout()
    save_fig(fig, "fig_bias_absorption")
    plt.close(fig)
